Name: The Phone Is Ringing
Author: Spiderbuttons
Description:
If you have a phone inside your house, you will rarely get a phone call, and it can be easy to not realize that if you're playing without volume or are hard of hearing or there's something else keeping you from hearing the ringing itself. The phone does shake a bit, but you have to be able to see the phone first to notice.

This mod will additionally put a pop-up notification in the corner of your screen telling you that the phone is ringing and how much longer you have before it stops ringing. It will also put a hovering exclamation point over the phone that bobs up and down to make it more noticeable, too. This way, you not only have the ringing and the slight shaking but a couple other much more noticeable visual cues to tell you to go answer it once you enter the place with the phone.

[b]Installation[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract the mod into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]Configuration[/b]
Use[b] [/b]Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the following options:
[list]
[*]HUD Notification: If enabled, you will get a pop-up in the corner of your screen telling you about the phone ringing. Enabled by default.[/*]
[*]Display Time Remaining: If enabled, the HUD pop-up will also show how much time is remaining before the phone stops ringing. Mods that affect time speed may make this inaccurate, hence being able to turn it off. Enabled by default.[/*]
[*]Exclamation Point: If enabled, a hovering exclamation point will bob up and down above the phone while it is ringing. Enabled by default.[/*]
[/list][url=https://github.com/Spiderbuttons/StardewBTN/tree/main/ThePhoneIsRinging]Source Code[/url]
